## 🕷️ Red Widow v__VERSION__ — first public release

Red Widow is a VS Code extension that lets AI agents run your pentest tooling inside offensive containers (Kali, Exegol), while you stay in control.

### Three ways to work
- **Supervised** — the agent proposes, you approve every sensitive action.
- **Automatic** — the agent runs the engagement on its own, within your rules of engagement.
- **Learning** — stuck on a box? The agent reads your terminal and points you in the right direction, without handing you the solution.

### Highlights
- 🐳 **Container orchestration**: agents execute tools directly in Kali / Exegol containers.
- 🧠 **Bring your own model**: Claude, GPT or local models via Ollama, powered by the opencode engine.
- 🔗 **Kill chain graph**: every step is mapped and can be replayed, from first scan to privilege escalation.
- 📜 **Full activity log**: every command and result is recorded (JSONL).
- 📝 **Report draft**: findings with severity levels, exported as Markdown.
